verses.en: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for it is nigh at hand;
verses.sm: Ia outou ilia le pu i Siona, ia taalili i loʻu mauga paia, ia tetemu i latou uma o e nonofo i le nuu; auá o le a oo mai le aso o le ALII, aua ua latalata mai.

verses.en: A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, even to the years of many generations.
verses.sm: O le aso pouliuli ma le pogisa, o le aso malumalu ma le pogisa lava, e pei o le malamalama o le taeao ona sosolo i mauga; o le nuu tele ma le malolosi, e leai sona tusa mai le vavau; a mavae ia e le toe faapea lava i lea tupulaga ma lea tupulaga.

verses.en: A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.
verses.sm: O loo i o latou luma le afi e fano ai, o loo i o latou tra foi le au mumu; o le fanua i o latou luma e pei o le faatoaga i Etena ia, a o latou tua, ua faalalaoina ia; e leai lava se mea e sao ia te i latou.

verses.en: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.
verses.sm: E tino mai i latou e faapei ona tino mai o solofanua; pei o e tietie i solofanua, e faapea lava ona latou taufetuli.

verses.en: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.
verses.sm: Latou te taufaioso, e pei o le taalili o kariota i tumutumu mauga, e pei o le taalili o le mu o le afi e susunuina ai tagutugutu o saito, e pei o le nuu malosi ua pae tau.

verses.en: Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.
verses.sm: E gatete tagata i luma ia te i latou, e sesega mata o tagata uma.

verses.en: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:
verses.sm: Latou te taufetuli e pei o tagata totoa; latou te tausili i le aupa e pei o tagata tau; latou te savavali taitasi i lona ala, latou te le “alo foi ai le mea e ui ai i latou.

verses.en: Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.
verses.sm: E le tulei le tasi i le tasi; latou te savavali taitasi i lona ala; a latou pauu foi i tao e le manunua ai.

verses.en: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.
verses.sm: Latou te femoei i le aai; latou te taufetuli foi i le aupa; latou te feaei i fale; latou te ulufale atu i faamalama e pei o se gaoi.

verses.en: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:
verses.sm: E tetemu le lalolagi i o latou luma; e luluina le lagi; e pouliuli le la ma le masina, o fetu foi e le toe fepulafi mai.

verses.en: And the LORD shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of the LORD is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?
verses.sm: O le ALII foi na te tùlei mai lona siufofoga i ana ‘au; aua e matua tele lava lana itu taua; aua e malosi o ia le na te faataunuuina lana afioga; aua e mamafa le aso o le ALII, e matua matautia, po O ai se na te mafaia ona talia?

verses.en: Therefore also now, saith the LORD, turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:
verses.sm: O lenei, ua faapea mai le ALII, Ia outou toe foi mai ia te au ma o outou loto atoa, ma le anapogi, ma le fetagisi, ma le tagiaue;

verses.en: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
verses.sm: ia outou saeia o outou loto, a e le o outou ofu, ma toe foi i le ALII lo outou Atua; aua e alofa fua, ma alofa mutimutivale o ia, e tele gese lona toasa, ua tele foi lona alofa, e salamo ia ona o le leaga.

verses.en: Who knoweth if he will return and repent, and leave a blessing behind him; even a meat offering and a drink offering unto the LORD your God?
verses.sm: Po o ai se tasi ua iloa, pe toe foi mai o ia, ma salamo, ma tuuina mai le manuia pe a mavae atu ia mea o le taulaga lea i mea e “ai ma le taulaga i mea e inu i le ALII lo outou Atua?

verses.en: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:
verses.sm: la outou ilia le pu i Siona, ia outou atofaina ni aso e anapogi ai, la outou tala'iina se faapotopotoga.

verses.en: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts: let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her closet.
verses.sm: la outou faapotopotoina le nuu, ia outou faapaiaina le potopotoga, ia outou faapotopotoina toeaina, la aofia tama iti, atoa ma e o fesusui; ja alu atu le faatoafaiava ai lona potu, ma le faatoanofotane ai lona afeafe.

verses.en: Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O LORD, and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?
verses.sm: la fetagisi le au ositaulaga o auauna a le ALII, i le va o le faapaologa ma le fata faitaulaga, ma ia latou faapea atu, Le Aw: e, ia e faasaoina lou nuu, aua foi e te tuuina atu lou tofi ia faalumaina, ina ne‘i fai ma faatusa o nuu ese; latou te faapea i se a i nuu, O ifea lo latou Atua?

verses.en: Then will the LORD be jealous for his land, and pity his people.
verses.sm: Ona fua lea o le ALII ona o lona nuu, na te alofa mutimutivale i ona tagata.

verses.en: Yea, the LORD will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:
verses.sm: E tali mai le ALII, ma faapea mai i lona nuu, Faauta mai, ou te foaiina atu ia te outou o saito, ma uaina, ma suauu tou te maoona ai; ou te le toe tuuina atu ia te outou ia faalumaina e nuu ese.

verses.en: But I will remove far off from you the northern army, and will drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, and his hinder part toward the utmost sea, and his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things.
verses.sm: Ou te faate‘a mamao ia te outou o “au mai le itu i matu, ou te tulia i latou i le nuu naumati ma le gaogao, e faasaga o latou mata i le sami i sasae; e u foi o latou tua i le sami tupito, e alu ae foi lo latou elo, e alu ae foi ma lona sauga, aua o mea tetele ua ia faia.

verses.en: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the LORD will do great things.
verses.sm: Le fanua e, aua e te fefe; ia e fiafia ma olioli, aua e faia e le ALH mea tetele.

verses.en: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth her fruit, the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.
verses.sm: O manu vaefa o le vao E, aua tou te fefefe, aua ua tupu le tuna i mea e tataa ai manu o le vyao, aua ua fua mai le laau i lona fua, o le mati atoa ma le vine ua matuá fua mai lava.

verses.en: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God: for he hath given you the former rain moderately, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first month.
verses.sm: O outou foi o le fanau a Siona e, ia outou fiafia ma olioli i le Aw lo outou Atua; aua ua ia foalina faatatau mai ja te outou le uaga muamua, na te faatotóina ifo foi le ua mo outou, o le uaga muamua, atoa ma le uaga mulimuli i le masina muamua.

verses.en: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the fats shall overflow with wine and oil.
verses.sm: E tutumu mea e sasa ai saito i saito, e taumasuasua o latou tuugauaina i le uaina ma le suāuu.

verses.en: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.
verses.sm: Ou te taui atu ia te outou o tausaga na “aina e le sé akerise, ma le sé aleka, ma le sé kasili, ma le sé kasama, o laʻu itu taua tele na ou auina atu ia te outou.

verses.en: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the LORD your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.
verses.sm: Tou te aai lava, ma maoona ai, tou te vivii atu foi i le suafa o le ALII lo outou Atua, o le ua faia vavega ia te outou; e le ma foi loʻu nuu e faavavau.

verses.en: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the LORD your God, and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.
verses.sm: Tou te iloa foi, ou te i ai ia Isaraelu, o aʻu lava o le ALII lo outou Atua, a e leai se tasi; e le mā loʻu nuu e faavavau.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:
verses.sm: Mulimuli ane, e iu ina ou liligi ifo ai loʻu Agaga i luga i tagata uma; ona perofeta ai lea o outou atalii ma o outou afafine, e fai miti o outou toeaina, e Poa faaaliga e o outou taulelea.

verses.en: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.
verses.sm: Ou te liligi ifo foi loʻu Agaga i auauna ma auauna fafine, i ia ona aso.

verses.en: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.
verses.sm: Ou te tuuina atu foi vavega i le lagi ma le lalolagi, o le toto, ma le afi, ma le asu faaniutu.

verses.en: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and the terrible day of the LORD come.
verses.sm: E muamua ona liua le la i le pouliuli, ma le masina i le toto, ile oo aii le aso tele ma le silisili o le ALII.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the LORD shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as the LORD hath said, and in the remnant whom the LORD shall call.
verses.sm: E iu foi ina faaolaina o i latou uma lava o e valaau atu i le suafa o le ALII; aua e i ai le faaolataga i le mauga o Siona ma Ierusalema, faapei ona fetalai mai ai o le ALII, e i ai foi i e ua totoe o i latou ia e valaauina e le ALII.
